
```jsx
import { CxBadge } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxBadge from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/badge/CxBadge'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | span |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **position** | Position badge in one of the corners of a link or button. | `'top-start'` \| `'top-end'` \| `'bottom-end'` \| `'bottom-start'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **shape** | Select the shape of the component. | `'rounded'` \| `'rounded-top'` \| `'rounded-end'` \| `'rounded-bottom'` \| `'rounded-start'` \| `'rounded-circle'` \| `'rounded-pill'` \| `'rounded-0'` \| `'rounded-1'` \| `'rounded-2'` \| `'rounded-3'` \| `string` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small. | `'small'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **textColor** | Sets the text context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `'white'` \| `'white-50'` \| `'muted'` \| `'black-50'` \| `'body'` \| `string` | - |
